subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

Many of her students live in two- or three-bedroom apartments with families of up to eight people, creating an environment **__rife__** with distractions.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"rife"** means something that is abundant or widespread, especially something undesirable or harmful. (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

 
 
• **Example: **The internet is rife with misinformation.
 
 
 
• **"Void"** refers to something that is completely empty or lacking. (रिक्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The abandoned building was void of any furniture.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'rife'** is **'void'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **void**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Alive** (जीवित): Having life or vigor.

 
 
• **Example:** The garden was alive with the sound of birds.
 
 
 
• **Replete** (संपूर्ण): Filled or well-supplied with something.
 
 
• **Example:** The book is replete with historical facts.
 
 
 
• **Thick** (घना): Having a large number of people or things close together.
 
 
• **Example:** The forest was thick with trees.
